screening.label: Simulated screening check
screening.method: Overall = 40% file readability + 40% job-keyword match + 20% content signals, rounded to steps of 5. Weights are our judgment, not calibrated to hiring outcomes.
screening.precision_note: Scores move in steps of 5 on purpose. A 70 and a 75 are not meaningfully different. The counts and the issue list matter more than the number.
screening.disclaimer: This is a simulation, not a real applicant tracking system. Every employer sets up its own software, and none of the big vendors publish exactly how they parse or rank resumes. This check looks for problems known to break resume parsing and for job-description requirements your resume doesn't show. A high score doesn't guarantee an interview, and a low score doesn't mean a robot rejected you. Most automatic rejections come from application questions (work authorization, location, degree, availability), and no resume edit changes those.
